title: yummy japanese rice bowl
description: grassy, pillowy, adventurous japanese dish featuring plum jam, nimono-simmer, buddhist-temple-friendly. a rice bowl that's both comforting and invigorating.
instructions: cook the short-grain japanese rice according to package instructions.
heat a tablespoon of oil in a pan over medium heat.
add the sliced shiitake mushrooms and cook until they're tender and fragrant, about 5 minutes.
add the plum jam and stir to combine, then cook for another minute.
simmer the nimono (mixed vegetables) in a separate pot of water for 10 minutes.
assemble the rice bowl by placing the cooked rice in a bowl, topping with the nimono and the mushroom-plum jam mixture.
